chapter.heading: Psalm 141
Give Ear to My Voice
A Psalm of David.
chapter.v: Give ear to my voice when I call to you!
keep watch over the door of my lips!
let me not eat of their delicacies!
my prayer is continually against their evil deeds.
then they shall hear my words, for they are pleasant.
be scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
in you I seek refuge; leave me not defenseless!
and from the snares of evildoers!

footnotes.footnote: 141:6 Or *When their judges fall into the hands of the Rock*
141:7 The meaning of the Hebrew in verses 6, 7 is uncertain
141:8 Hebrew *refuge; do not pour out my life!*
